dedupe_keys.name: terrascope belgian earth observation platform and eoplaza

description: Terrascope is the Belgian Earth observation platform run by VITO, with the Belgian Science Policy Office, that makes open satellite images easy to use. It gives access to a range of Earth observation data and services: users can view satellite images in the Terrascope viewer, download time series, process data on the platform, and offer their own services through the EOplaza marketplace, which matches supply and demand for EO services. Use cases on the home page include daily surface nitrogen dioxide maps produced with machine learning, the WorldCereal global cropland and crop type maps at 10 metre resolution, and continental crop type mapping with openEO, and the site covers water and coast, nature and environment, infrastructure and agriculture applications. Support includes documentation, a forum, how-to videos and webinars, and some functions need a Terrascope account. Access to the open imagery is free, and no licence is stated on the home page. Caveats: services on the EOplaza are offered by different providers, and the home page does not list product terms. Coverage is Belgium, with global products such as WorldCereal. It supports hazard exposure analysis, such as drought and flood monitoring around infrastructure; related records are Digital Earth Australia and the DLR EOC Geoservice.
